translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 29.5.2018 (radio)

More cars and ships are being made in Finland than before. There are many students with immigrant backgrounds in vocational education. A shooting has happened in Belgium. It may soon be possible to pay with a bank card on Helsinki trams. The weather varies in different parts of Europe.
## Car manufacturing
![The Uusikaupunki car factory](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10140026)
Open image viewer
There is a lot of work at the Uusikaupunki car factory. Photo: Jyrki Lyytikkä / Yle
There is good news from industry.
More cars and ships are now being made in Finland than before. The number will grow by more than 20 percent this year.
The growth will continue next year too. Then the growth will be 15 percent.
A research institute says that the production of cars and ships is growing faster in Finland than generally in the European Union area.
## Vocational education
![Security guard students at Stadin ammattiopisto.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10229227)
Open image viewer
Namik Ali, Samba Jarreh and Rahimy Najibullah are studying to become security guards at Stadin ammattiopisto. Photo: Antti Kolppo / Yle
There are many students with immigrant backgrounds in vocational education. The number of students with immigrant backgrounds is also growing quickly.

For example, about 30 percent of the students at the Helsinki vocational college already speak a foreign language. Students who speak a foreign language have a mother tongue other than Finnish or Swedish.
Many immigrants study in technical fields, for example.
## The shooting in Belgium
![map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10228177)
Open image viewer
A man shot 3 people in the city of Liège in Belgium. Photo: Yle News Graphics
There has been a shooting in Belgium. The shooter killed 3 people. The shooter also died, when the police shot him.
The incident started when a man attacked 2 female police officers. The man took a gun from the police. Then he shot the police officers and 1 other person.
The man had previously been in prison for a drug crime. Belgian authorities say that the shooting may have been an act of terrorism.
## Paying on the tram
![A tram drives in Helsinki](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10228767)
Open image viewer
It may soon be possible to pay on the tram with a bank card. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Passengers on Helsinki trams may be able to pay for their journey in a new way next year. The plan is that passengers can pay for the journey with a bank card.
Payment works so that the passenger shows a bank card to a card reader. The passenger does not need to show the bank card to the driver.
Paying by bank card suits people who travel rarely well. Tourists can also easily pay by bank card on the tram.
If the trial on the trams succeeds, the new payment method will also be introduced on other types of transport.
## The weather in Europe
![grass scorched by drought](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10221509)
Open image viewer
It is dry in Finland now. Photo: Marja Väänänen / Yle
The weather varies in different parts of Europe.
For example, the wine region of France has had very bad weather. At the weekend there were hailstorms in the region. The rain caused great damage to vineyards in France.

Here in Finland no rain has fallen. That is why the ground is so dry that a forest can easily catch fire. The Finnish Meteorological Institute warns of a forest fire risk across a large part of Finland.
